lines.speaker: Alex Rivera
lines.text: Hey Priya, thanks for jumping on. Let's do a quick sync on the Q3 roadmap before the planning review tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Sounds good. I pulled together the engineering estimates last night, so I can walk through those.

lines.speaker: Alex Rivera
lines.text: Perfect. Let's start with the search revamp. Where are we on that?

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Search is about seventy percent done. The full text indexing is live in staging, but we still need to wire up the ranking logic.

lines.speaker: Alex Rivera
lines.text: Okay, and do you think that's still on track for the September fifteenth launch?

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: It's tight, but yes, if we can get one more engineer on ranking for a few days, we should make it.

lines.speaker: Alex Rivera
lines.text: I can pull Sam off the billing project for the rest of this week to help with that.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: That would help a lot. I'll send Sam the ranking spec right after this call.

lines.speaker: Alex Rivera
lines.text: Great, let's make that an action item. Now, what about the mobile notifications work?

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: That one's blocked. We're waiting on the design team to finalize the notification preferences screen.

lines.speaker: Alex Rivera
lines.text: I'll follow up with design today and try to get an answer by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Perfect, that unblocks us immediately once we have it.

lines.speaker: Alex Rivera
lines.text: One more thing, I want to flag that the customer feedback on the new onboarding flow has been really positive.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Oh that's great to hear, I was worried the extra step might annoy people.

lines.speaker: Alex Rivera
lines.text: Nope, actually the opposite, several customers specifically called it out as a highlight in their feedback.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Good, let's keep an eye on the metrics over the next couple of weeks to confirm the trend holds.

lines.speaker: Alex Rivera
lines.text: Agreed. Okay, I think that covers the main items. To summarize, Sam joins ranking work this week, I'll chase design on notifications by Thursday, and we keep monitoring onboarding metrics.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Sounds right. I'll send the updated roadmap doc after this call too.

lines.speaker: Alex Rivera
lines.text: Perfect, thanks Priya. Talk soon.

lines.speaker: Priya Nair
lines.text: Thanks Alex, bye.
